description: Indoor point cloud dataset for BIM related applications is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Nuno Abreu, Rayssa Souza (INESC TEC). Annotated point cloud of the CRAS labs@FEUP. The point cloud is in ASCII format. Variables: Point X coordinate (m); Point Y coordinate (m); Point Z coordinate (m); Point colour (R); Point colour (G); Point colour (B); Intensity; Label. A total of 21 scans were made, producing 584,701,977 points. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
